title: Signature: Transfer impact ledger
description: Signature-original design by Justin Addam Higgins (JAH): every cross-border transfer is recorded with its data, volume, basis, and approver. The ledger shows cumulative exposure per corridor: how much data has moved EU-to-US this quarter and under what bases. Impact visibility guides policy tightening. At ladder rank 1 (foundation), this record covers per-transfer records with basis and approver.
demo:
LEVEL = 1
CFG = {1: 2, 2: 6, 3: 15}
N = CFG[LEVEL]
transfers = [{"corridor": "EU-US", "gb": 10, "basis": "adequacy"} for _ in range(N)]
total = sum(t["gb"] for t in transfers)
print("transfers:", N, "| EU-US exposure: %d GB" % total)
